description: Travis Kalanick, Ben Horowitz, and Erik Torenberg reunite to reflect on Uber's early days, the investment that almost happened, and why Kalanick believes the next great technology opportunity lies beyond software. They discuss the lessons of building Uber, the value of founder-led companies, and why Kalanick spent nearly eight years quietly building Atoms before stepping back into the spotlight. The conversation explores industrial AI, robotics, autonomy, mining, food production, and Kalanick's…
classificationReason: Discusses industrial AI, robotics, autonomy, mining, manufacturing, and digitizing the physical world, but robotics is part of a broader founder and industry conversation.
qualityReason: Substantive discussion with experienced founders and investors about technology, industry transformation, and company building.
